entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi Diana... I hope you can help me. I need to return something, and I'm just so disappointed it didn't work out.
I'm certainly sorry to hear that. I can look into a return for you. To get started, could you tell me the item and what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

It's a helmet I bought as a gift. It's really just a preference thing... the color wasn't what they wanted. I feel terrible about it, and I've been a loyal customer for a long time. I really needed that money back.
I understand completely. Let me just pull up your order information. Do you have the order number handy?
Yes, it's VF58921-C. The box is still unopened, I haven't even looked at it since it arrived. I know VeloFit is all about safety, and it's a great helmet, but it just won't be used.
Thank you for that. One moment while I review this... Okay, I see the helmet was delivered 56 days ago.
Oh, has it been that long? I've had so much going on. I was really hoping you could still help me. It's a lot of money to just lose.

No need to worry. I've just checked our policy, and for a standard item like this, you are well within the 90-day return window. Since the box is unopened, I can absolutely process this return for a full refund for you.
Oh, really? That's such a relief! Thank you so, so much, Diana. You have no idea how much I appreciate that.
Of course, I'm happy to help. I am sending a pre-paid return label to the email address on file right now. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and you can drop it off at any shipping center.
That's wonderful. I'll get that sent back today. You've really made my day.
I'm glad I could help. Once we receive the item back at our warehouse, your refund will be processed in 3-5 business days. Was there anything else for you today?
No, that was everything. Thank you again!
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
